messages.subject: Project Forge — CMA accepts undertakings; next steps on divestment
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace, Richard,

Good news to round off the Phase 1 process: the CMA has formally accepted the undertakings in lieu and confirmed it will not refer the merger to Phase 2. The matter now moves to implementation — selling the Aqualis line to a CMA-approved purchaser within the four-month window, under the Monitoring Trustee's oversight. We'll project-manage that with you and Birchall Stone.

We'll send a short closing note and our final invoice for the Phase 1 work. It's been a good outcome — the core industrial rationale of the Halworth deal is preserved.

Best
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
